description: This file defines the 'ClaimExpense' entity class for the OrangeHRM application. It models a claim expense record including fields such as expense type, date, amount, note, and associated claim request, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database mapping.

classes.name: ClaimExpense
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim expense record with properties for expense type, date, amount, note, associated claim request, and deletion flag. Provides getter and setter methods for each property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the claim expense.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the claim expense.

methods.name: getExpenseType
methods.description: Returns the type of expense associated with this claim expense.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Sets the expense type for this claim expense.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the expense.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the expense.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the expense.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount of the expense.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the expense, if any.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the expense.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Returns the claim request associated with this expense.

methods.name: setClaimRequest
methods.description: Associates a claim request with this expense.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the expense is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense as deleted or not.
